spans.s: 1. सेन mfn. (7. स + इन) having a master or lord, dependent on another, Vās.
2. सेन (?) n. the body, L.
3. सेन (for 1. 2. See col. 2), in comp. for सेना.
a missile, dart, spear, RV.; AV.
N. of Indra's wife (or his thunderbolt so personified), TS.; AitBr.; Vait.
an army, armament, battle-array, armed force (also personified as wife of Kārttikeya; ifc. also n(सेन). ), RV. &c. &c.
a small army (consisting of 3 elephants, 3 chariots, 9 horse, and 15 foot), L.
any drilled troop or band or body of men, Bālar.
a kind of title or addition to the names of persons (also names of courtezans), Sāh. (cf. Pāṇ. iv, 1, 152 &c.)
N. of a courtezan (abridged fr. कुबेर-सेना), HPariś.
of the mother of Śambhava (the third Arhat of the present Avasarpiṇī), L.
सेना—कक्ष m. ‘the flank of an army’ and ‘an army compared to dry wood’, MBh.
सेना—कर्मन् n. the leading or managing of an army, ib.
सेना—गोप m. the keeper of an army (a partic. office), ib.
सेना˚ग्नि (˚नाग्नि), m. the Agni of an army, Kauś.
(˚नाग्र)m n. the front or van of an army, R.
सेना—ग्र—ग m. ‘going at the front of an army’, a general, ib.
सेना—ग्र—गामिन् m. ‘going at the front of an army’, a general, ib.
सेना˚ङ्ग (˚नाङ्ग), n. the component part of an army (supposed to consist of four divisions: elephants, chariots, cavalry, and infantry), Ragh.; VarBṛS.
a division of an army
सेना—˚ङ्ग—पति m. the leader of a division, Kām.
सेना—चर m. ‘going with an army’, a soldier, warrior, MBh.; Rājat.
सेना˚जीव or सेना˚जी˚विन् (˚नाज्˚), m. ‘living by or with an army’ id., MBh.
सेना˚जीव or सेना˚जी˚विन् (˚नाज्˚), m. ‘living by or with an army’ id., MBh.
सेना—जू॑ mfn. swift as an arrow, RV.
सेना˚धिनाथ (˚नाध्˚), m. the chief of an army (see सर्व-सेन्˚)
N. of a man, Vās., Introd.
सेना˚धिप (˚नाध्˚, VarBṛS.) m. the commander of an army.
सेना˚धिपति (Jātakam.) m. the commander of an army.
सेना˚ध्यक्ष (Hariv.) m. the commander of an army.
सेना—नाथ m. N. of an author, Cat.
सेना—नी॑ m. (nom. ˚नी॑स्; dat. abl. pl. ˚नि॑भ्यस्; Gr. also acc. sg. ˚न्यम्; loc. ˚न्याम् &c.) the leader of an army, commander, general, chief, RV. &c. &c.
N. of Kārttikeya (god of war), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
of one of the Rudras, Hariv.
of a son of Śambara, ib.
of a son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra, MBh.
of a die (the head of a host of dice), MW.

Vārtt. 3
सेना—˚नि-ग्रामणी॑ m. du. the leader of an a˚ and the chief of a village, VS.
सेना—पति m. the general of an a˚, AitBr. &c. &c.
N. of Kārttikeya, L.
of Śiva, MBh.
of a son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra, ib.
सेना—पति—त्व n. generalship, ib.
सेना—पति—पति m. the chief commander of an army, ib.
सेना—पत्य n. (prob. w.r. for सैनाप्˚) commandership, generalship, ib.
सेना—परिच्छद् mfn. surrounded by an a˚, Ragh.

सेना—प्रणेतृ m. the leader of an a˚, ib.
सेना—बिन्दु m. N. of a king, ib.
सेना—भङ्ग m. the breaking of an a˚, rout, disorderly flight, MW.
सेना˚भिगोप्तृ (˚नाभ्˚), m. the guardian of an army, Kām.
सेना—मुख॑ n. the van of an a˚, TBr.; ŚBr.
a division or company of an a˚ (consisting of 3 or 9 elephants, 3 or 9 chariots, 9 or 27 horses, 15 or 45 foot-soldiers), MBh.

सेना—मुखी (ई), f. N. of a goddess, Rājat.
सेना—योग m. equipment of an a˚, MBh.
सेना—रक्ष m. ‘army-protector’, a guard, sentinel, L.

सेना—स्थ m. ‘being in an army’, a soldier, L.
सेना—व्यूह m. battle-array, L.
सेना—समुदय m. an assembled a˚, MBh.
सेना—स्थान n. a camp, L.
सेना—हन् m. N. of a son of Śambara (v.l. सेन-ह्˚), Hariv.
सेन—हन् See सेना-हन् above.
सेन—कुल n. the family of the Senas (i.e. of persons and princes whose names end in सेन; cf. under सेना), Buddh.
सेन—जि॑त् mfn. vanquishing armies, VS.

of a son of Śambara, Hariv.
